description:
A presentation containing a linked revenue chart has a broken link because the source file was moved. You must fix the broken link on Slide 2. 

The presentation is located at '~/Documents/Presentations/Q3_Performance.odp'. 
The slide deck expects the chart at '~/Documents/Assets/Old/revenue_chart.png', but the file has been moved to '~/Documents/Assets/New/revenue_chart.png'.

Use 'Edit > Links to External Files' to update the source path to the new location so the image appears correctly. Do NOT simply delete and re-insert the image (it must remain a linked file). Save the presentation when finished.
